response_template: Hello! I am the Zenith Nova HR assistant. Ask me about leave, payslips, attendance or policies.
Goodbye! Message me anytime.
You are welcome!
You get 12 casual leave and 12 sick leave days each financial year, plus earned leave at 1.25 days per month (carry forward up to 30 days).
Office hours are 9:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with core hours from 11:00 to 16:00.
The holiday calendar is published each year. The next holiday is {next_holiday}.
Salary is credited on the first working day of the next month.
Open the Leave screen, choose the leave type and dates, then submit. Your manager gets an approval request.
Submit bills within 30 days in the Expenses screen. Your head of department approves, Finance pays in the next cycle.
Payroll queries: payroll@znova-demo.example. Benefits and policies: hr@znova-demo.example. IT: it-help@znova-demo.example.
Most roles follow a hybrid pattern with about three office days a week. Remote roles are listed in your offer letter.
Notice is 30 days (L1-L2), 60 days (L3) or 90 days (L4 and above). Buy-out needs HR and manager approval.
Probation is six months. Confirmation is reviewed by your manager and HR.
Group health insurance covers you, spouse and up to two children. Add dependents within 30 days of joining or a life event.
PF is 12% of basic salary (ceiling 15,000 basic) from both you and the company.
Upload investment proofs in the Tax screen before the cut-off. TDS is calculated on projected annual income.
You have {cl} CL, {sl} SL and {el} EL days left.
